facts.text: McLeansville sits in eastern Guilford County, just a few blocks north of US 70, the main corridor that links the town to Greensboro and surrounding communities.
South Buffalo Creek traces the western edge of the CDP, feeding into the Reedy Fork Creek–Haw River–Cape Fear River watershed.
The town’s center hosts a grocery store, post office, several small businesses, and a handful of churches that have served residents for decades.
Rolling farmland, wooded areas, and suburban homes dominate the northern outskirts, giving McLeansville a mix of rural charm and modern development.
A Publix Supermarket distribution center sits along US 70, reflecting the town’s role in regional food logistics.
Strip malls with grocery stores and other businesses line the outlying areas, illustrating McLeansville’s gradual commercial expansion.
